name: Connectome Workbench -surface-resample
purpose: Resamples a surface file, given two spherical surfaces that are in register.

inputs.statement: The surface file to resample, typically a native-mesh anatomical or inflated surface.
inputs.quote:
<surface-in> - the surface file to resample, typically a native-mesh
anatomical or inflated surface

inputs.statement: A sphere surface in register with <new-sphere> that uses the mesh the input surface is currently on, typically a registered native-mesh sphere.
inputs.quote:
<current-sphere> - a sphere surface that is in register with <new-sphere>
and uses the mesh that the input surface is currently on, typically a
registered native-mesh sphere

inputs.statement: A sphere surface that has the desired output mesh, typically a standard sphere.
inputs.quote:
<new-sphere> - a sphere surface that has the desired output mesh,
typically a standard sphere

inputs.statement: The method name, which must be one of ADAP_BARY_AREA or BARYCENTRIC.
inputs.quote:
The <method> argument must be one of the following:

ADAP_BARY_AREA
BARYCENTRIC

conditions.statement: If ADAP_BARY_AREA is used, exactly one of -area-surfs or -area-metrics must be specified.
conditions.quote:
If ADAP_BARY_AREA is used, exactly one of -area-surfs or
-area-metrics must be specified.

steps.statement: Provide the surface file to resample as <surface-in>.
Provide the current-sphere mesh-registered sphere as <current-sphere>.
steps.quote:
<current-sphere> - a sphere surface that is in register with <new-sphere>
and uses the mesh that the input surface is currently on, typically a
registered native-mesh sphere

steps.statement: Provide the desired output mesh sphere as <new-sphere>.
steps.quote: <new-sphere> - a sphere surface that has the desired output mesh

exceptions.statement: For cut surfaces (including flatmaps), use -surface-cut-resample instead.
Instead of resampling a spherical surface, the -surface-sphere-project-unproject command is recommended.
exceptions.quote:
Instead of resampling a spherical surface, the
-surface-sphere-project-unproject command is recommended.

exceptions.statement: ADAP_BARY_AREA is not generally recommended for surface resampling, but is provided for completeness.
exceptions.quote:
If ADAP_BARY_AREA is used, exactly one of -area-surfs or
-area-metrics must be specified. This method is not generally
recommended for surface resampling, but is provided for completeness.

parameters.statement: Optional -area-surfs specifies surfaces for vertex area correction: <current-area> with current-sphere mesh and <new-area> with new-sphere mesh.
parameters.quote:
[-area-surfs] - specify surfaces to do vertex area correction based on
<current-area> - a relevant surface with <current-sphere> mesh
<new-area> - a relevant surface with <new-sphere> mesh

parameters.statement: Optional -area-metrics specifies vertex area metric files for current-sphere and new-sphere meshes.
parameters.quote:
[-area-metrics] - specify vertex area metrics to do area correction based
on
<current-area> - a metric file with vertex areas for <current-sphere>
mesh
<new-area> - a metric file with vertex areas for <new-sphere> mesh

parameters.statement: Advanced -bypass-sphere-check allows current and new 'spheres' to have arbitrary shape as long as they follow the same contour.
parameters.quote:
[-bypass-sphere-check] - ADVANCED: allow the current and new 'spheres' to
have arbitrary shape as long as they follow the same contour

parameters.statement: The method argument must be ADAP_BARY_AREA or BARYCENTRIC.
parameters.quote:
The <method> argument must be one of the following:

ADAP_BARY_AREA
BARYCENTRIC
